status: Engineering recommendation for discussion; not a production art contract or implementation approval
recommendation: Use modular hero locomotion, authored directional grip poses, separate weapons and effects. Reserve combined animations for exceptional attacks.
migration: Keep existing combined sprites as a fallback until a complete modular set is reviewed.
Prototype Tony with pressure gun and Sean with heavy plunger only; do not regenerate the full weapon roster yet.
Validate idle, run, jump, recoil and damage with horizontal, upward diagonal, up, downward diagonal and down aiming; mirror left directions.
Promote the modular renderer only after small-window visual review confirms hand contact, stable scale and no duplicate weapon silhouettes.

proposed_coordinates.rule: Registration anchor maps to collision feet at player+[13,46]. Airborne frames retain the same virtual anchor; never normalize individual pose bounds.
proposed_coordinates.source_scale: Prefer exact 1x logical pixels or one documented integer multiplier shared by all layers; nearest-neighbor sampling.
proposed_coordinates.anchors: Grip, support-hand and muzzle in source-frame pixels, measured relative to top-left before mirroring. Source rectangle, registration anchor and scale required per frame.
proposed_coordinates.mirror: Reflect all image layers and anchor x offsets around the same registration anchor; reflect projectile direction too.
proposed_coordinates.weapon_dimensions: Use padded 128x128 source frames initially; tightly cropped delivery is allowed only with explicit source rectangle and anchor offsets.

layer_contract: Weapon-free body/legs locomotion frames sharing one registration anchor and scale.
Back arm, weapon, front arm/hand layers with explicit per-direction order; avoid a universal order that hides support hands.
Authored five right-side/cardinal aim directions; use mirrored counterparts to cover eight-way aim without rotating the torso.
Grip families reduce combinations, but support-hand locations and recoil offsets remain weapon-specific.
Use one locomotion phase for all layers. Torso/arm attachment offsets may vary with run phase; do not animate each layer on independent timers.
Recoil moves weapon and attached hands together while keeping the body registration stable. Muzzle effects inherit the recoil-adjusted muzzle.
Runtime aiming permissions remain separate from art availability. Missing poses must be explicit fallback limitations, never silently enabled weapon abilities.

tradeoffs.benefit: New weapons normally need weapon poses/anchors and grip-family adjustments rather than every complete hero animation.
tradeoffs.cost: Up-front clean-body and arm sets, careful anchor measurement, per-direction occlusion and synchronized animation are required.
tradeoffs.pixel_consistency: Prefer authored cardinal/diagonal weapon sprites over arbitrary rotation; avoid subpixel wobble by snapping final draw positions consistently.
tradeoffs.exceptions: Whips, long cables, planted tools and full-body specials may justify bespoke combined animations.

prototype_gate: Review both heroes and both starters in idle/run/airborne states, all permitted directions, both facings and recoil. Check hand contact, muzzle alignment, no foot pop, no detached layers, and unchanged collision shapes.
